entities.text:
High Court For The State Of Telangana
 At Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
This Criminal Petition has been filed seeking to quash the proceedings in F.I.R. No.325 of 2024 of Domalguda Police Station, wherein the petitioners were arrayed as accused Nos.3 to 8, 11 and 12 for the offences punishable under Sections 223 and 126(2) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (for short, "BNS"), and Section 3 of the Prevention of Adulteration Act, 1922 ( for short 'PA-1922') and Section 4 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act (for short 'PFA').
2.
Heard Mr.Kiran Palakurthi, learned counsel for the petitioners and Mr.V.Jithendar Rao, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for respondent No.1.

3. During the course of hearing, the learned Additional Public Prosecutor, basing upon the written instructions furnished by the Sub-Inspector of Police, Domalaguda Police Station, Hyderabad, dated 06.03.2026, submitted that the Investigating Officer after conducting investigation had filed the final report before the learned X Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Secunderabad and the case was numbered as C.C.No.1075 of 2025.

entities.text: X Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Secunderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission of this Court to withdraw the present criminal petition.

6. Accordingly, the criminal petition is dismissed as withdrawn granting liberty to the petitioner to file a fresh petition seeking quashing of the proceedings in C.C.No.1075 of 2025, by raising all the grounds including the grounds which are pleaded in the present criminal petition.
Pending miscellaneous applications, if any, shall stand closed.
